label: alarm_set
text: Tya alarme na ngonga ya motoba ya tongo.
english_meaning: Set an alarm for six in the morning.

label: alarm_set
text: Nalingi alarme ebeta na ngonga ya sambo.
english_meaning: I want the alarm to ring at seven.

label: alarm_set
text: Tya ngai alarme ya kolamuka lobi na ngonga ya mitano.
english_meaning: Set an alarm to wake me up tomorrow at five.

label: alarm_set
text: Longola alarme oyo natyaki mpo na ngonga ya mwambe.
english_meaning: Cancel the alarm I set for eight o'clock.

label: calendar_set
text: Tya rendez-vous na calendrier na ngai mpo na mokolo ya mibale.
english_meaning: Add an appointment to my calendar for Tuesday.

label: calendar_set
text: Koma likita na ngai ya lobi na calendrier.
english_meaning: Put tomorrow's meeting in my calendar.

label: calendar_set
text: Nakokutana na monganga mokolo ya mitano tya yango na calendrier.
english_meaning: I will meet the doctor on Thursday; add it to the calendar.

label: calendar_set
text: Tya rendez-vous na ngai ya mosala na ngonga ya zomi na moko.
english_meaning: Add my work appointment at eleven o'clock.

label: calendar_query
text: Na mokolo ya misato, nazali na rendez-vous?
english_meaning: Do I have an appointment on Wednesday?

label: calendar_query
text: Na poso oyo, nazali na makita nini?
english_meaning: What meetings do I have this week?

label: calendar_query
text: Mokolo nini nakokutana na monganga?
english_meaning: Which day am I meeting the doctor?

label: calendar_query
text: Ezali na likita mosusu oyo natye na calendrier na ngai?
english_meaning: Is there another meeting I added to my calendar?

label: lists_createoradd
text: Sala liste ya biloko oyo nasengeli kosomba.
english_meaning: Create a list of things I need to buy.

label: lists_createoradd
text: Bakisa mapa na liste ya biloko ya kosomba.
english_meaning: Add bread to the shopping list.

label: lists_createoradd
text: Koma bankombo ya baninga oyo nabengi na liste.
english_meaning: Write the names of friends I should call in a list.

label: lists_createoradd
text: Bakisa loso na liste ya biloko ya kolya.
english_meaning: Add rice to the food list.

label: lists_query
text: Biloko nini ezali na liste ya kosomba?
english_meaning: What items are on the shopping list?

label: lists_query
text: Nani azali na liste ya bato oyo nasengeli kobenga?
english_meaning: Who is on the list of people I need to call?

label: lists_query
text: Lakisa ngai liste ya biloko oyo nakomaki.
english_meaning: Show me the list of items I wrote down.

label: lists_query
text: Nasilaki kosomba biloko nini na liste?
english_meaning: Which items on the list have I already bought?

label: play_music
text: Yembela ngai miziki ya Fally Ipupa.
english_meaning: Play Fally Ipupa's music for me.

label: play_music
text: Tya miziki ya rumba ya kala.
english_meaning: Play old-school rumba music.

label: play_music
text: Nalingi koyoka ka mwa miziki boye.
english_meaning: I feel like listening to some music.

label: play_music
text: Tya loyembo oyo nalingaka mingi.
english_meaning: Play the song I like most.

label: news_query
text: Nini ya sika ezali koleka na Kinshasa?
english_meaning: What is happening in Kinshasa?

label: news_query
text: Sango ya lelo ezali nini?
english_meaning: What is today's news?

label: news_query
text: Nini ya sika ezali koleka na mboka?
english_meaning: What is happening in the country?

label: news_query
text: Pesa ngai sango ya sika na oyo etali politiki.
english_meaning: Give me the latest political news.

label: qa_definition
text: Maloba oyo elingi koloba nini?
english_meaning: What do these words mean?

label: qa_definition
text: Bokeseni ezali nini kati na mayele mpe boyebi?
english_meaning: What is the difference between intelligence and knowledge?

label: qa_definition
text: Mpo na nini bato basalelaka telefone ya smartphone?
english_meaning: Why do people use smartphones?

label: qa_definition
text: Boyokani ezali nini?
english_meaning: What is cooperation?

label: weather_query
text: Lobi na tongo moyi ekobima?
english_meaning: Will the sun come out tomorrow morning?

label: weather_query
text: Na mpokwa mapata ekozala mingi?
english_meaning: Will it be very cloudy in the evening?

label: weather_query
text: Molunge ekosila na mikolo oyo?
english_meaning: Will the hot weather ease in the coming days?

label: weather_query
text: Nakoki kobima lelo kozanga kokutana na mbula?
english_meaning: Can I go out today without getting caught in the rain?

label: datetime_query
text: Lelo mokolo ya nini?
english_meaning: What day is it today?

label: datetime_query
text: Sikoyo ngonga boni?
english_meaning: What time is it now?

label: datetime_query
text: Tokomi na sanza nini?
english_meaning: Which month are we in?

label: datetime_query
text: Lobi ekozala mokolo ya nini?
english_meaning: What day will it be tomorrow?
